children.text: Worked as a Web Designer, developing responsive web interfaces and reusable frontend components. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver user-focused websites while optimizing performance, maintaining code quality, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

responsibilities: Developed responsive web interfaces using HTML and CSS.
Built reusable frontend components and scalable stylesheets.
Performed QA testing and fixed layout/rendering issues across browsers.
Optimized UI performance and improved page load times.
Collaborated with designers and developers to deliver client-focused solutions.
Managed website updates and deployments using FileZilla.
Maintained responsive layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
achievements: Reduced code redundancy by 20–30% through reusable components.
Reduced UI bugs by 25–30% by identifying and fixing rendering issues.
Improved page load performance by 15–20% through optimized frontend structure.
Received Employee of the Quarter recognition for quality work and ownership.
